name: Algerian Current
scope: Eastward Algerian coastal regional reference route from an OSW Alboran-transition gate to an OSW eastern Algeria gate. Alternative later western and earlier eastern gates test regional extent. Excludes Alboran gyres, detached Algerian eddies and downstream Sardinia-channel or other Mediterranean circulation. Source does not define exact terminal coordinates or whole-system termination.
layer: Surface Atlantic Water regional coastal reference geography; no velocity-derived current axis.
time_convention: Regional source-description convention; not a complete observed trajectory from the 2014-2016 glider surveys.
source_locator: Cotroneo et al. (2019), section 1: after leaving the Alboran Sea, Atlantic Water flows eastward along the Algerian coast in an along-slope Algerian Current; the study surveys the Algerian Basin, not the complete named-current axis.
source_citation: Cotroneo et al. (2019), Glider data collected during the Algerian Basin Circulation Unmanned Survey, Earth System Science Data 11, 147-161, doi:10.5194/essd-11-147-2019.
coordinate_selection: OSW chooses coarse offshore regional gates at -1.5/0 E and 7/8 E and intervening waypoints. No exact start/end longitude is asserted by the source; these conventions delimit the Algerian coastal route for comparison.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Later western regional gate at 0 E.
Earlier eastern regional gate at 7 E.
Both inner regional gates; no physical current absence outside them implied.

scenario_rule: Four regional start/end conventions crossed with three whole-route longitude offsets and independent endpoint latitude offsets of -0.1/0/+0.1 degrees: 108 editorial scenarios; not empirical uncertainty.
